title: Fable users, what is your weekly token bill like?
author: Advanced_Invite9435
selftext:
Ball park figures please. I wanna use fable for a few weeks.

  
Currently I use opus medium and use all my weekly tokens

comments.body: Which plan are you on? On pro plan i cant even try fable, on max plan i use it all the time on medium without hitting any limits

replies.body:
Claude pro.
I was given a free sample of fable last week.

replies.author: Advanced_Invite9435
replies.body: How much extra did you pay?

replies.body: I mean like I have the $20 plan, for the amount of work I have it, opus would have used 7% of my 5 hour limit and fable used like 34% and for my weekly usage it ate like 20% it was honestly fucking stupid I’d rather just use opus because I already know how I use it and how to go about using it

comments.author: Freelanncer
comments.body: Honestly running 2 fable instancen konkurent with 3 agents max right now on ultimate used the first reset since friday 14:00 now

replies.author: Advanced_Invite9435
replies.body: What sorta money are we talking? Big bucks?

comments.author: Furyan9x
comments.body:
I used fable to perform a thorough audit of my project for 4. reasons:

 1. Refine my process of idea>research>plan>implement>test>fix>test>ship. 

2. Set up my workspace for practical daily usage, adding proper tracking of all tasks, plans, ideas, goals, rules, skills, etc. 

3. Organize my project folder and properly archive/delete left over files from completed tasks. 

4. Examine all written code, including scripts and tests, and provide a full report of what is efficient, what is over engineered, and what can be done for the sake of optimization. 

He ran 5-8 sub agents for around 1 hour and 50 minutes, did everything I asked, and I used 13% of my 5 hour limit on the max 5x plan. I ran it on High. 

Now was it good work? Who knows. I have a better organized workspace now, I have a better daily process that has a better natural flow, produces more understandable reports, and my documentation is much clearer and its now possible to read the state of my entire project at a glance at any given time. 

I think Fable did eally well for this task, I'm just still unsure of what to use it for over Opus. Maybe I'll ask him lol

replies.author: Advanced_Invite9435
replies.body: So you just signed up for max, but you didn't pay for extra tokens?

replies.author: Furyan9x
replies.body: Nope, no extra tokens. I was already on Max and have been working with opus/sonnet/haiku for about a month now. I got an alert that said I could use fable 5.2 for up to 50% of my weekly usage, so I tried it out. I read here about it eating usage so I was skeptical at first, but for this task he barely used anything.

comments.author: DaedalusRaistlin
comments.body:
I only use Fable when my weekly reset is getting close. I can have 4 or 5 Opus agents going and never hit my 5 hour limit on Max, but I send one Fable prompt and a quarter of my weekly usage is gone and my 5 hour limit was hit. 

I most recently had it fix performance issues in my building destruction kit, which it did very well. But so does Opus, usually. 

I just don't see a lot of value in it when it cuts into my limits so hard. Opus seems more than capable. Even Sonnet can handle a lot of the more mundane tasks.
